target_text: TBFs (VT 8) from Saratoga, with VB 3 and VS 3, sink Ryujo at 06°10'S, 160°50'E and damage seaplane carrier Chitose
notes: Cressman, 24 August 1942: SBDs and TBFs (VB 3, VS 3, VT 8) from Saratoga (CV-3) sink Ryujo (06°10'S, 160°50'E) and damage seaplane carrier Chitose. The mission is embarked and is validated by the Saratoga Air Group relation and Saratoga claim C13104 (option b). No aircraft counts in the entry used. Confidence 0.5 (sea_position cap).

target_text: TBFs (VT 8) from Enterprise, with USMC SBDs (VMSB 142) and TBFs (VMSB 131) from Henderson Field, sink battleship Hiei
notes: Cressman, 13 November 1942: battleship Hiei, already damaged by gunfire in the Friday the 13th night action, is sunk by TBFs (VT 8) from Enterprise and USMC SBDs (VMSB 142) and TBFs (VMSB 131) from Henderson Field. Cressman attributes the TBFs to Enterprise; VT 8 also has a Henderson Field base claim in force from 7 November (C13389), and no mid-November Enterprise sea position is given in the pages read, so the mission is validated by that shore base claim. Confidence 0.7: one official Navy chronology (mission rubric). The target place is Ironbottom Sound (kind area), not a sea_position.
